content.title: Sean Penn wins best supporting actor Oscar for ‘One Battle After Another' but opts not to attend - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Jonathan Landrum Jr. | APLOS ANGELES — Sean Penn has built one of the most decorated careers in contemporary acting, and he has added another Oscar to the list.On Sunday, Penn won the Academy Award for best supporting actor for his performance in Paul Thomas Anderson’s political drama “One Battle After Another.” He delivered a commanding portrayal of a seasoned power broker navigating the shifting loyalties and ideological battles at the center of the film.2 CommentsMost ReadHannah SampsonAirlines surprise passengers with ‘flights’ that are busesEarlier todayHannah KnowlesBigotry among young conservatives has Republicans on edgeEarlier todaySusannah George and Rachel ChasonGulf countries want Trump to end Iran war — but not yet, officials sayEarlier todayAnahad O’ConnorWhat an expert on the gut microbiome eats in a dayEarlier todayOpinionKathleen ParkerA new nightmare awaits Americans at the airport1 hour agoNoah Robertson and Ellen FrancisPentagon considers diverting Ukraine military aid to the Middle EastEarlier todayView 3 more storiesView 3 more storiesNewsletterAs news breaksEntertainment AlertsBreaking news email alerts on important stories in the entertainment world.Sign up5.57.1 Already have an account?
